summary: monday.com Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held August 6, 2026. Shareholders re-elected three Class II directors (Zinman, Eyal, Jenner) with 95-98% approval; approved the Compensation Policy for Executive Officers and Directors (99.14% total), Co-CEO Compensation Package (98.82%), Non-Employee Director Compensation Package (99.78%), and reappointed Deloitte as auditor (99.76%). All proposals passed with requisite majorities under Israeli law. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no special-situation elements. The filing incorporates by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms, strategic actions, or activist activity. What to watch: none; routine AGM results.
